jobs.title: Independent Trustee and Chair of the Board, BBC Pension Trust
jobs.reason: This is a senior board-level Trustee and Chair appointment for a pension scheme, requiring extensive governance, pensions/financial and leadership experience the candidate does not have. It is entirely off-profile (pension fund governance, not IR/policy/research) and a Chair-of-Board seniority well beyond entry-level.

jobs.title: Brand and Cultural Research Manager
jobs.reason: This is a brand/cultural insight role in market research and marketing strategy — off the candidate's policy/IR/risk profile (FIELD 2). The "Manager" title with essential criteria demanding proven experience shaping strategic narratives, influencing senior stakeholders, and delivering organisation-wide insight programmes points to mid-level professional experience the candidate lacks. London option exists so location is fine, but the field mismatch and seniority bar drive a Low.

jobs.title: Operations Team Leader
jobs.reason: This is a media-production operations and line-management role, entirely off the candidate's policy/research/intelligence profile, requiring multi-skilled content production, technical streaming knowledge and team management experience the candidate lacks. Off-field, off-skills, and the management remit puts it above entry level.

jobs.title: Senior Audience Research Executive
jobs.reason: This is an audience/market research role (media measurement, survey methodology) — not international affairs, policy, security, or intelligence work, so it sits off the candidate's profile. The "Senior" title and essential "proven experience managing impactful research projects" plus deep quantitative survey-methodology expertise (CAPI/CATI) push beyond entry-level and the candidate's analysis-level skillset.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a senior software engineering role requiring extensive production experience in functional/statically-typed languages (Elixir, Erlang, Rust, Go), AWS infrastructure, and CI/CD — specialist technical skills the candidate's analysis-level Python cannot substitute for. It is also off-profile (pure software engineering, not policy/research) and senior-level, triggering multiple Low conditions.
